text:
anya: Noticing a few different quickstart snippets are out of sync and causing small but noisy onboarding friction — raising here before I open a PR. Observed issues: curl auth header uses single quotes, JS fetch example uses template string but the env var name mismatches, Python requests snippet passes json and data together, and the Rust sample in the repo misses tokio::main so it won't compile for new users. Also the quickstart blurb says 'SDKs retry transient errors' but doesn't list defaults.

rachel: Ugh. Saw two support threads this week about the curl failure on Windows. Example in README currently: 

```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```

That breaks in pwsh because single quotes prevent env expansion.

matt: Also the fetch example in quickstart uses process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN in examples but other languages show REDWOOD_API_KEY. Inconsistent and confusing. Code snippet: 

```js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hi' })
})
```

We should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere.

lia: Python requests snippet does this: 

```py
import requests
res = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers={ 'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY')}" }, json={'input': 'hi'}, data={'foo': 'bar'})
```

Passing both json and data is bad practice and caused a user to get a 400 when they were trying to attach form fields. We should remove data and only show json in the quickstart.

sam: Rust sample in examples/simple.rs lacks a tokio runtime wrapper. New users compiling with cargo run see: "error: function cannot be a coroutine". Current file starts with async fn main() without #[tokio::main]. Add the attribute or switch to synchronous reqwest blocking example.

anya: Good catch. Let's batch these into one small docs PR: 1) Add POSIX + PowerShell curl variants and a short "shell note"; 2) Standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere and add a changelog note about old names; 3) Fix fetch snippet to use REDWOOD_API_KEY; 4) Fix Python example to only pass json; 5) Fix Rust example to include #[tokio::main] and add a Cargo.toml note about tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros"] } or provide a blocking example; 6) Add a tiny table in quickstart troubleshooting that lists SDK retry defaults (Node: off, Python: 3, Go: 2, Rust: follow client settings) and link to SDK retry doc.

rachel: Also suggest adding a short "if curl fails on Windows" FAQ line in onboarding emails. That reduced tickets last time.

matt: I'll draft the PR and include minimal test steps for each snippet (bash, pwsh, node, python, cargo). Will add a devex checklist entry so future PRs run the snippet smoke tests.

lia: I'll update the onboarding template and the quickstart landing section copy to call out "OS/terminal differences" with links to both variants.

sam: I'll add a short note to the SDK docs about retry defaults and an example to opt-in for Node retries (showing client construction with retries: true and maxRetries).

devex-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/3033 ; draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678 (assigned to @matt)

matt: Picking this up now. ETA for PR by EOD today, will ping support after merge. :thumbsup:
